text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk one day, I spotted a 
familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...! *gasp*...! Ba-Bakushin, 
Bakushiiin!
choice_data_list: Isn't that... Bakushin O's little sister?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
! Yes! She is practicing for the 'Chibi 
Horse Girl Footrace Tournament'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The 'Chibi Horse Girl Footrace 
Tournament.' I recalled the event I had 
observed the other day. If I remember 
correctly, her sister's result was...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She seemed really frustrated about getting 
10th place. 'I'm gonna Bakushin!!' she 
said, and she's super fired up, desu ne.
choice_data_list: You're supporting her too, Chiyono O.

You've been helping her out too, Chiyono 
O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Since Bakushin O-san and I are good 
friends in the same club, desu ne.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Through that connection, I became friends 
with her sister too... She's actually 
really good at making sweets! We've even 
cooked together♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm! But whatever could be the matter? She 
normally runs much faster than this.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Just like Big Sis... to become the 
strongest horse girl... I'll Bakushin!
choice_data_list: Her form definitely looks a bit awkward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Her form! I see?! ...I see?!
choice_data_list: Mind if I join in on the training?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Really, are you sure?! Well, it's just 
about time for lunch break, so we can 
discuss her practice routine then—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Our bellies full from lunch, our minds 
full of training ideas! With that settled, 
let us get right to training—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what is this?! 'Challenge! The 
Competitive Speed-Eating Mega Challenge 
Menu'?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Speed-eating—which is to say, Bakushin 
eating?! As the older sister, shouldn't I 
Bakushin through this... and inspire my 
little sister?!
choice_data_list:
It says '0 Successful Finishers to Date', 
you know?!

It literally says 'No One Has Ever Beaten 
It', you know?!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
B-Bakushin...! Then I've gotta Bakushin 
together with Big Sis too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't push yourself too hard, Little 
Sister-chan?! Even adult horse girls 
haven't been able to finish it all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, we must fight! Little Sister! We 
cannot afford to lose when it comes to 
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The result was total defeat.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, a formidable foe indeed... However, 
this class president shall undergo her 
second and third transformations to power 
up, and surely conquer that nemesis... 
*urgh*.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... I couldn't even eat half as 
much as Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
My running times haven't improved at all 
either... ...Bakushin is really hard, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O is fine as always. 
Rather, her little sister's despondency 
was concerning. Isn't there any way to 
cheer her up?
choice_data_list:
Oh! They sell delicious-looking sweets 
here!

Ah! Look, they're selling delicious treats 
over there!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um... everyone is completely stuffed right 
now, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bad idea.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but these look just like the sweets 
I made with Big Sis long ago.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How nostalgic! You were so good at 
teaching me, it convinced me on the spot 
that you would make a splendid class 
president in the future!
choice_data_list: As expected of Bakushin O's little sister.

She's truly Bakushin O's sister, isn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! And that's not all! Cleaning, 
laundry, sewing, crafting small items...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
She can handle everything that I am just a 
wee bit clumsy at—

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Geez, Big Sis, you're always so clumsy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I understand... I understand now! What it 
is that my little sister truly needs!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
What... I need...? What is it? Tell me, 
Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall tell you... only when I have 
acquired what is needed solely through my 
own power!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And with that, let us call it a day!
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll be cheering for you.
Let me help you with the preparations!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your understanding! I have 
preparations to attend to, so farewell for 
now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-And off she goes. Are you sure we 
shouldn't help her, desu ka...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still wondering what Sakura Bakushin O had 
come up with... we disbanded for the day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No! For this, and this alone, it is 
absolutely, absolutely, absolutely... out 
of the question!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I must do this secretly by 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed that for her sister's growth, 
Sakura Bakushin O needed to accomplish 
something entirely on her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, after the subsequent tournament, 
word reached me that her little sister had 
achieved fantastic results.
